proposed_from.topic: Target-span completeness for rank-deficient proxy transport. In a strictly positive finite latent-shift SCM E→U→{W,X}, with Y allowed to depend on U,W,X, source law P(E,W,X,Y), target proxy law Q(W), invariant mechanisms, and unknown full-column-rank proxy channel M=P(W|U), prove for every x that Q(Y|do(x)) is identified iff Q(W) belongs to col(B_x), B_x=P(W|E,x). On success prove every lambda solving B_x lambda=Q(W) yields the same functional P(Y|E,x)lambda. On failure construct two strictly positive SCMs agreeing on the entire supplied source and target laws but differing on the intervention law. Add Anderson–Rubin-style projection confidence sets robust to weak rank. Consumer: Iglesias-Alonso et al.'s Expedia hotel-ranking analysis. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The presolver derived B_x=M R_x, c_x=g_x^T R_x, and theta_x=g_x^T q. Injectivity of M gives the success functional and solution independence. Outside the span, a proxy-stratum-specific left-null perturbation preserves every source joint cell while changing the target effect; exact rational checks covered all 24 cells of paired positive countermodels and the supplied deficient-rank success witness. It also checked incomplete proxies, deterministic outcome boundaries, signed weights, other treatment arms, and abstract nullspace/source-span collisions. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Identification is derived, but uniform studentized Anderson–Rubin calibration under diverging balancing weights and degenerate covariance remains open; the causal novelty must also survive exact comparison with Zhang Proposition 2.3 and Rahiminasab Theorem 3. EARLY KILL TEST: Compare the proved converse line-by-line with those two results and stop if either already implies the identical deficient-source-rank SCM iff with full-joint-law countermodels. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/scm_proxy_targetspan_transport.md.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The proposal does not claim novelty for span algebra, bridge solution independence, finite proxy completeness, or projection as a generic inference device. Its new kernel is the causal realizability equivalence: for every compatible positive latent-shift law, target-span membership is sufficient despite an unknown factorization, while target-span failure admits a local pair of strictly positive SCMs that agree on every source \((E,W,X,Y)\) cell and the target proxy law yet disagree on the intervention distribution. The exact rational witness proves that this frontier strictly enlarges the anchor's full-source-rank regime. The finite-sample projection set is a supporting weak-rank guarantee; the sharper studentized uniform theorem is exposed rather than assumed. Zhang et al. subsume the solution-independence half, Rahiminasab et al. occupy the full-rank prediction analogue, and neither supplies the full-law causal converse on which the novelty rests.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Determine whether a target intervention law is identified exactly when its target proxy mixture lies in the observed treatment-specific source span.
seed_details.anchor_read: Iglesias-Alonso et al., Introduction, Theorem 1, Appendix A.1, Appendix B.2, and Summary; Zhang et al., Introduction, Proposition 2.3 with its affine-null-space proof, Lemma 2.4, and Discussion; Rahiminasab et al., Introduction, Definition 3, Theorems 2--3 with the operator-span proof, and Conclusion.
seed_details.summary: Prove the observable target-span condition is necessary and sufficient over the entire positive compatible-SCM fiber and derive the common balancing functional.
seed_details.referee_objection: Immediate from Zhang et al. Proposition 2.3 because target-span membership is only null-space annihilation in finite dimensions.
seed_details.rebuttal: That proposition proves constancy on a fixed bridge-solution fiber; it does not show that every failed observed span admits two positive latent-shift SCMs preserving the entire source joint law and target proxy law while retaining an injective unknown proxy channel.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Lift an observed left-null separator to a nondegenerate family of strictly positive full-law-equivalent SCMs.
seed_details.anchor_read: Iglesias-Alonso et al., Appendix B.2, change only the target latent law under a deficient proxy channel; Duarte et al., Introduction, polynomialization theorem, anytime primal--dual construction, and Conclusion, optimize over full finite compatible-SCM laws.
seed_details.summary: Use a proxy-stratum-specific outcome perturbation divided by the proxy channel cell to cancel every source joint-cell derivative while changing the target effect.
seed_details.referee_objection: A single hand-tuned counterexample already appears in Iglesias-Alonso et al. Appendix B.2.
seed_details.rebuttal: The proposed construction starts from every compatible interior model, keeps the proxy channel full column rank and the target latent law fixed, and produces an interval of observationally equivalent effects using an observed separator.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Give honest causal projection coverage without a rank lower bound or bounded balancing coefficients.
seed_details.anchor_read: Iglesias-Alonso et al., reduced estimator and pointwise confidence interval section, use a full-rank pseudoinverse; Dufour and Taamouti, Introduction, Theorems 4.1 and 5.1--5.3 with the quadric projection proof, and Conclusion, invert a joint AR region before scalar projection.
seed_details.summary: Rewrite balancing with unconditional multinomial moments, use coordinatewise concentration scaled by the profiled \(\ell_1\) norm, and project onto the causal probability.
seed_details.referee_objection: This is only a Bonferroni application of Hoeffding's inequality.
seed_details.rebuttal: The calibration is elementary, but the exact profiled moment geometry yields finite-sample coverage uniformly over changing rank and unbounded balancing weights; it is retained as an inference rung, not the causal novelty claim.
seed_details.status: survived as a supporting inference theorem

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Calibrate a studentized projected AR set uniformly when balance rank and multinomial covariance rank change and the nuisance fiber is unbounded.
seed_details.anchor_read: Dufour and Taamouti, Theorems 4.1 and 5.1--5.3, project quadric AR regions; Andrews and Guggenberger, Equations 4.5--4.9, Theorem 6.1, Section 9.2, Theorem 9.1, and the empirical conclusion, retain stochastic covariance directions and separately test nonstochastic identities.
seed_details.summary: Profile the two-sample balance and outcome restrictions over unrestricted weights using singularity-robust standardization and drifting-sequence critical values.
seed_details.referee_objection: Andrews and Guggenberger's subvector SR-AR theorem already gives uniform validity.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their subvector parameterization requires compact, smooth, strongly identified nuisance geometry and covariance conditions that fail when balancing weights are nonunique, unbounded, and estimated from coupled multinomial tables.
seed_details.status: survived as the first-class open-ended question

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Characterize regular root-\(n\) estimation by an observable target-relevant certificate rather than the smallest global singular value.
seed_details.anchor_read: Bennett et al., Introduction, Theorem 1, the functional strong-identification theorem, the singular-system example, and Conclusions, use a dual representer in the range of \(P^{\star}P\); Zhang et al., Lemma 2.4 and its tangent-space proof, distinguish null-space identification from adjoint-range root-\(n\) estimability.
seed_details.summary: Derive the efficient influence function and information bound as the minimum variance of a target-balancing representation and characterize divergence along weak-rank sequences.
seed_details.referee_objection: Finite-dimensional multinomial efficiency is a routine delta-method calculation once a minimum-norm solution is chosen.
seed_details.rebuttal: At changing rank, the minimum-norm map is discontinuous and the relevant regularity condition is target-directional; a full efficiency frontier would need factorization-preserving tangent paths and is not routine, but it is less directly causal than the chosen seed.
seed_details.status: survived literature scan but not selected

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Characterize sharp transported-effect bounds outside the source span over the full shared-channel SCM fiber.
seed_details.anchor_read: Ghassami et al., Introduction, Theorems 1--2 with their bridge-ratio proof, LogSumExp inference section, and Conclusion, bound a different proximal model; Duarte et al., polynomialization theorem and anytime algorithm, give generic finite-SCM optimization; Iglesias-Alonso et al., Appendix B.2, establish only nonuniqueness.
seed_details.summary: Encode the unknown shared injective channel, source mixtures, response kernel, and target mixture as a polynomial feasible set and seek attained sharp endpoints with dual certificates.
seed_details.referee_objection: AutoBounds already makes this an immediate model-instantiation exercise.
seed_details.rebuttal: Generic polynomialization does not supply an explicit transport-specific feasible reduction, endpoint geometry, or positive sharpness certificate, but the computation and factorization-realizability burden is substantially larger than the chosen iff theorem.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Find the exact causal-functional quotient when both the target latent mixture and the unknown proxy factorization are nonunique.
seed_details.anchor_read: Rahiminasab et al., Definition 2, Theorems 2--3, and Conclusion, quotient latent states into proxy-induced classes; Zhang et al., Proposition 2.3, handles one affine bridge fiber; Ghassami et al., Theorems 1--2, retain proxy information after completeness failure.
seed_details.summary: Characterize constancy of the causal functional over the nested feasible fiber of \(M\), \(q\), source factorization, and response mechanisms.
seed_details.referee_objection: Rahiminasab et al.'s latent-equivalence classes already provide the required quotient.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their predictor theorem fixes quotient components and assumes source rank over their mixtures; the causal query here may vary within an equivalence class and across observationally equivalent factorizations, so the first injectivity step genuinely changes.
seed_details.status: survived novelty scan but deferred for feasibility

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Characterize identification of arbitrary linear contrasts across several treatment arms by joint span conditions.
seed_details.anchor_read: Iglesias-Alonso et al., the ATE extension following Theorem 1, subtract treatment-specific identifying formulas; Zhang et al., Proposition 2.3, treats general linear functionals of bridge solutions.
seed_details.summary: Test whether a contrast can be identified even when some arm-specific probabilities are not, through cancellation of realizable null directions.
seed_details.referee_objection: With unrestricted treatment-specific response slices, each failed arm can be perturbed separately, so identification reduces immediately to the span condition for every nonzero contrast coefficient.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds in the stated unrestricted model; nontrivial cancellation would require cross-arm response restrictions absent from the topic.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Quantify sensitivity of target-span transport to bounded source--target violations of the proxy and outcome mechanism invariances.
seed_details.anchor_read: Iglesias-Alonso et al., Introduction, structural assignments in Equation 1, Theorem 1 proof, and Summary, make mechanism invariance load-bearing but do not parameterize its failure.
seed_details.summary: Seek explicit effect bounds under a total-variation invariance radius and a critical radius at which an effect sign becomes unidentified.
seed_details.referee_objection: A total-variation radius on latent conditional kernels is not observed-data calibrated and can manufacture any desired sensitivity curve.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds without a defensible observed proxy for the latent radius or a published invariance metric, so this seed is not sufficiently anchored for v1.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Choose the smallest subset of source environments that preserves identification for a prespecified collection of target proxy laws.
seed_details.anchor_read: Rahiminasab et al., the distinguishing-environment definition and PQAL acquisition theorem, select environments to obtain full quotient rank; Iglesias-Alonso et al., Theorem 1, treats the supplied source set as fixed.
seed_details.summary: Use a target-aware column-basis problem to select source domains needed for several intervention targets.
seed_details.referee_objection: With population matrices known, the smallest exact spanning subset is ordinary matroid basis selection; with unknown matrices, the question becomes an application-specific sampling design not fixed here.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the present formulation; a nontrivial design theorem would need costs, sampling noise, and an explicit regret or power criterion.

proposed_from.literature_map: Iglesias-Alonso et al. (2025, Theorem 1) identify the same target intervention distribution by a right-pseudoinverse when \(P(W\mid E,x)\) has rank at least \(\lvert\mathcal U\rvert\); Appendix B.2 establishes generic failure by using a noninjective proxy channel. Zhang et al. (2023, Proposition 2.3) already own the abstract affine-solution and null-space-annihilation argument, while Lemma 2.4 separates identification from root-\(n\) estimability. Rahiminasab et al. (2026, Theorem 3) express a target prediction operator as a source-environment linear combination under full rank over latent-equivalence-class mixtures; this is a prediction theorem and does not give a target-specific deficient-rank causal converse. Miao, Geng, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2018) and Shpitser, Wood-Doughty, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2023) supply the finite proxy-rank and graphical proximal-ID foundations but require proxy completeness or sequential bridge conditions rather than the proposed observed target-span frontier. Tsai et al. (2024, Proposition 4.3) occupies the adjacent multi-domain prediction target under full source posterior rank. Dufour and Taamouti (2005) establish exact projection geometry for linear-IV AR regions. Andrews and Guggenberger (2019) establish full-vector identification- and singularity-robust AR size and subvector results with regular nuisance restrictions. Bennett et al. (2023) and Severini--Tripathi's range logic, as used by Zhang et al., show why regular inference needs more than functional uniqueness. Ghassami, Shpitser, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2023) derive incomplete-proxy bounds in a different proximal-confounding model, while Duarte et al. (2024) give general finite-SCM polynomial machinery. A bounded exact-title, theorem-keyword, and target--method search found no paper that states the same full-observed-law causal if-and-only-if theorem with an injective proxy channel, deficient source rank, and a particular target proxy mixture.
